text:
olivia: Quick sync — drafting the compliance sprint for audit logs + BYOK onboarding. Need to break work into milestones with explicit acceptance gates for MVP (SOC2 readiness, searchable audit exports, KMS handshake). Who can own gating criteria?
sam: I can own SLI/SLO definitions. Proposal: two SLIs — audit-write success >= 99.95% and audit-search 95th p95 < 300ms for hot index. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
mike: 300ms for search is tight if we include archive. Can we define hot vs cold boundaries? Suggest hot_window = 30d, cold is archive with a different SLA (export within 24h).
tara: For BYOK, acceptance should include: CMK registration + verification, rotate-without-data-loss proof, and an automated handshake test that shows successful decrypt after onboarding. Estimate: need a small harness and test vectors.
natalie: Product & legal asks: SOC2 checklist must map to retention proofs, keystore audit trail, and role separation. Legal wants retention options (30/90/365) and a documented export flow for e-discovery.
sam: I'll add tasks: SLI doc, test harness endpoints, canary rollout plan. Draft retention config example below for discussion:
```yaml
audit:
  retention_days: 90
  hot_window_days: 30
  export_sla_hours: 24
```
mike: +1. Also need a quick cost estimate for hot index storage. If hot_window_days=30, ballpark index size / shard -> ~12GB per TB ingested in hot. Will model monthly delta.
olivia: Good perf/cost callouts. Next steps: sam — own SLI/SLO doc and perf targets, tara — BYOK test harness and handshake smoke tests, natalie — SOC2 acceptance matrix & legal notes. Sync Fri 10am to lock gates.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 3/4 nodes, fallback policy -> default encrypted-at-rest path if BYOK handshake fails (auto-rollback enabled).
natalie: I'll put the acceptance matrix in the doc repo by Thu EOD and flag any legal exceptions.
olivia: Thanks everyone — add any missing owners or edge cases now. :thumbsup:
